response.justification: Technically strong and well-credentialed engineer, but a poor match for this specific opening. The role is entry-level and requires strong verbal and written German plus Java proficiency; the candidate has ~15 years of senior/staff-level experience (mismatched seniority and likely compensation expectations), only basic German, and Java appears as a minor, dated item in a stack dominated by TypeScript/Node.js and DLang. No insurance-sector or consulting-client exposure is evident. He would likely be a fit for a senior backend or platform role, but not for this junior Java consulting position.
strengths: Deep, broad engineering experience across web, mobile, embedded and distributed systems
Strong agile/craftsmanship practice: TDD, pairing, CI/CD, trunk-based development, Docker/Kubernetes
CS degree, active open-source work, and proven teaching/mentoring through workshops and talks
concerns: German listed as basic; role requires strong written and spoken German
Severely overqualified for an entry-level individual contributor position
Java is peripheral and dated (last used ~2018); core stack is TypeScript/Node and DLang
